We all know how difficult it is sometimes to determine if this is actually a vegan product. We understand that a large number of additives are added to products. But not all of these supplements are suitable for vegans. Some may not be vegan and some may even be harmful. That's why we created this application. We want to know exactly what we eat and whether it really meets the vegan criteria.
Vegans refuse to consume all types of meat, milk, eggs, honey, as well as other substances and additives produced with the use of animals (such as gelatin or carmine).

We tried to make the application interface simple and intuitive for everyone.
